newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish BG Bank 96 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish BG Bank 96 profit seen up.

text.p: Analysts polled by Reuters in a survey released on Friday forecast on average moderately higher 1996 profits for Denmark's third biggest banking group BG Bank.
Eight foreign and local analysts forecast average 1996 profits before tax and extraordinary items of 1.972 billion crowns for BG Bank, compared with 1.885 billion crowns in the previous year.
BG Bank is due to announce its 1996 results on Monday.
Last August, BG Bank posted first-half 1996 pre-tax profits of 821 million crowns.
This compared with the same 1995 period's 738 million crowns and BG Bank said it expected better core activity earnings for whole year 1996 than in 1995.
In bank results issued in recent days Jyske Bank, the fourth biggest Danish bank, is so far the only one to post higher profits for 1996.
Den Danske Bank and Unidanmark, the two top banks, both reported lower profits.
BG Bank was formed from a merger of the former post office Giro Bank and Bikuben savings bank on January 1, 1996.
